Bond Forfeit: In the event that the land is not restored in accordance with the approved plans as determined by the Zoning Inspector, at the time stated in the permit or any extension thereof granted by the Board of Zoning Appeals for good cause shown, or if the applicant fails to file the annual report required above, or if the applicant deviates from the plan approved by, or the conditions stipulated by the Board of Zoning Appeals, the Board of Township Trustees shall declare the conditions of the bond forfeited and proceed to cause the land to be restored in accordance with the approved plan submitted by the applicant charging such cost to the bond.
